name: Card & Relic Tier Overlay (Mobalytics)
author: ilikehotandcold-ux
description:
Shows the Mobalytics tier (S/A/B/C/D) on cards and relics: rewards, shop, chests, Neow options, your deck, card inspect and relic tooltips. Tier data syncs from GitHub at startup.

Made with Claude Code using Claude Opus 5.5 (high effort).

https://github.com/ilikehotandcold-ux/sts2-card-tier-overlay
